settings.heading: Pokémon card vending machines
settings.body: The machines you've seen at the shows — now available for your shop, event or arcade. Custom TCG Hitz wrap, Pokémon · Magic · One Piece, built to draw a crowd.

settings.question: Can I buy a vending machine?
settings.answer: Yes — we build custom-wrapped machines for shops and events. Send an enquiry and we'll scope it with you.

settings.question: Which games can it dispense?
settings.answer: Pokémon, Magic and One Piece packs and mystery products — configurable per machine.

settings.question: Do you help with setup?
settings.answer: We handle the wrap and configuration, and support you with restocking and spares.
